summary: Luke Badiali reviewed systems with James Whitlow and Sophie Archer. Ashcombe runs origination on spreadsheets and partner inboxes, with no shared relationship history. We agreed to move to a relationship-intelligence CRM built for private equity and set up a weekly origination dashboard.

discussion.keyPoints: Sophie keeps the tracker in Excel; partners hold relationships in Outlook. James was worried about losing intermediary relationships when people leave.
We compared a PE-specific relationship CRM at about £18,000 a year against a general CRM. Sophie preferred the PE-specific one for automatic email capture.
Around a third of the 340 targets have missing founder age or EBITDA.

recommendations.recommendation: Adopt a PE-specific relationship-intelligence CRM at around £18,000 a year, live by the end of Q1.
Fill founder age, EBITDA band and sub-sector for every qualified target before migration.
Run a weekly origination dashboard for the Monday partner meeting showing new contacts, first meetings and qualified founders.
Do not forecast deal completions from the CRM until 6 months of clean data exist.

actions.action: Book demos with two PE-specific CRM vendors
Mock up the Monday origination dashboard

nextFocus: Plan campaigns and thought leadership to support founder outreach.
nextPreparation: James to share any articles or reports Ashcombe has published in the last 2 years.

tests.question: What does the Monday dashboard show?
Which fields must be filled before migration?
